text:
Situation: Chloroprocaine hydrochloride is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. An earlier shortage first posted 2021-05-17 is resolved. Corvale East holds 30 vials of 20 mg/mL 20 mL (8.1 days). Corvale General holds 64 vials of 20 mg/mL (15 days) and 65 vials of 10 mg/mL (14.5 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 13 vials of 20 mg/mL 20 mL (18 days) and 8 vials of 10 mg/mL 30 mL (11 days). Current supply uses Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. product (NDC 00143920910) manufactured at HIKMA FARMACÊUTICA (PORTUGAL).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspected Fresenius Kabi USA LLC (FEI 1450022) on 2020-05-18 and classified it OAI, 364 days before the 2021-05-17 shortage posting. A second OAI inspection at the same plant ended 2022-06-30, 409 days after the shortage posting. The OAI classification letters for those inspections were dated 2024-05-22 and 2024-04-30, well after the shortage posting.

Our position: No active FDA shortage exists. Inventory is adequate at Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside but low at Corvale East. Transfers can bridge Corvale East to two weeks of supply. Alternate concentrations from Hikma and Fresenius Kabi are approved for pharmacist-verified use.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 2 vials of 20 mg/mL 20 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 4 vials of 20 mg/mL 20 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Use Hikma 20 mg/mL alternate concentration or vial size — pharmacist verification required; approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD on 2025-10-17.
4. Use Fresenius Kabi 10 mg/mL alternate concentration or vial size — pharmacist verification required; approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD on 2026-06-28.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
